trust_decision.summary: Whether a <name>.coverage file next to a PHPT test was written by PHPUnit's own coverage child process (trusted) or pre-existed in the checked-out tree (untrusted); the fix decides this only by its absence, checked once in the PhptTestCase constructor; the unserialize itself already uses allowed_classes=false at the pin.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'unsafe deserialization in PHPT code coverage handling', and the only unserialize() in the PHPT runner is in cleanupForCoverage(), which already has allowed_classes=false at the pin.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `phpunit <dir|file.phpt>` -> TestSuite::addTestFile (src/Framework/TestSuite.php:371-379) -> new PhptTestCase($filename); public API: new PhptTestCase()
fix_sites.module_kind: test runner core (constructor guard added at fix.diff:40)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A PHPT file is already arbitrary PHP that the runner executes, and the child's shutdown handler overwrites the .coverage file (src/Util/PHP/Template/PhptTestCase.tpl:30-36), so a solver can argue a planted file is harmless or already mitigated by allowed_classes=false at src/Runner/PhptTestCase.php:614.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Normal PHPT coverage collection: the child process must still write <name>.coverage and the parent must still read it, merge it and unlink it. A guard that rejects any existing file after the run, or drops coverage reading, breaks coverage for PHPT tests.

O6_input_shapes: pre-existing <basename>.coverage file next to the .phpt (any content, including an empty file per fix.diff:69-71)

O7_producer.where: src/Util/PHP/Template/PhptTestCase.tpl:35 (child writes serialize($output) to {coverageFile}); path built at src/Runner/PhptTestCase.php:550-559

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The <basename>.php job file next to the .phpt is written and later unlinked without any pre-existence check, a realistic sibling if a planted job-side artefact were read back.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It comes from the same getCoverageFiles() pair; a maintainer guarding only 'coverage' would plausibly forget 'job'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The isolated-test processResultFile is read and unserialized without allowed_classes (src/Util/PHP/AbstractPhpProcess.php:300); a copy that derived its path from the test file name rather than tempnam (src/Framework/TestCase.php:814) would be a real second implementation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same 'child writes a serialized result to a file, parent unserializes it' pattern in another package (Util/PHP vs Runner).

O9_family: CWE-502 deserialization of an untrusted file planted in the repo (poisoned pipeline execution)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.2+ CLI with composer dependencies (8.5 branch)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/end-to-end/phpt/*.phpt end-to-end tests driven by PHPUnit\TextUI\Command::main (the fix adds tests/end-to-end/phpt/phpt-coverage-file-exists.phpt)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add or rely on ['allowed_classes' => false] in cleanupForCoverage (already present at the pin) instead of refusing to run when the .coverage file pre-exists.

out_of_scope_notes: src/Util/PHP/AbstractPhpProcess.php:300 unserializes child stdout/result without allowed_classes, but the file is a fresh tempnam() file (src/Framework/TestCase.php:814), so a PR cannot pre-plant it.
src/Runner/PhptTestCase.php:492 FILE_EXTERNAL reads arbitrary relative paths; this is a different weakness and was not pursued.
The fix checks at construction time and the check runs before SKIPIF/FILE code (src/Runner/PhptTestCase.php:155, 179), so a TOCTOU window exists, but PHPT code is already executed code.
